seoTitle: Lux to Foot-Candle Converter with Typical Light Levels
metaDescription: Convert lux, foot-candles and phot and compare with typical light levels for homes, offices and daylight. Free.
intro: Converts illuminance between lux, foot-candles and phot and lists rough light levels from moonlight to direct sun.
why:
Light meters and lighting guides use lux in most of the world and foot-candles in the US. One foot-candle is 10.76 lux.

A short list of typical levels helps you judge a reading. They are rough orientation values, not a lighting standard.
howTo: Compare the result with the typical levels.

faq.q: What lux is right for an office?
faq.a: Guides often say 300 to 500 lux for desk work. Check your local standard.

faq.q: Is lux the same as lumens?
faq.a: No. Lux is lumens per square metre, so it depends on area.
